item.title: Trump’s Gaza ‘Board of Peace’ Takes Centre Stage at World Economic Forum in Davos Amid Global Scepticism
item.description: US President Donald Trump plans a high-profile Board of Peace for Gaza, but major allies remain wary.

item.title: 8-Year-Old Hindu Child Withdrawn From London School After Alleged Discrimination Over Tilak
item.description: An alleged lack of religious sensitivity at a London primary school has sparked concerns over inclusivity and equality protections for Hindu students.

item.title: From Road Accident to Communal Violence: 2 Dead as Assam’s Kokrajhar Sees Lynching, Army Deployment and Internet Shutdown
item.description: A road accident in Assam’s Kokrajhar escalated into mob violence, killing two people and prompting heavy security deployment.

item.title: Land, Livelihoods and Law: Why Over 20,000 Farmers and Tribals Laid Siege in Maharashtra’s Palghar
item.description: A massive CPI(M)-led march of farmers and tribal communities reached Palghar, triggering a standoff as protesters pressed long-pending land, livelihood and environmental demands.

item.title: Did India Stop Buying Russian Oil After Trump’s Tariff Threats? US Treasury Secretary Weighs In
item.description: US Treasury Secretary claims India halted Russian oil purchases after Trump imposed a 25 percent tariff.

item.title: After ₹22.20-Crore Fine, IndiGo Assures DGCA of Enough Pilots, No Flight Cancellations After Feb 10
item.description: Facing strict scrutiny after mass disruptions, IndiGo has assured DCGA it has enough pilots to operate smoothly once flight duty exemptions end on February 10.

item.title: Madhya Pradesh: 14 Students Injured as ‘Pirate Ship’ Swing Collapses at Jhabua Fair, Magisterial Inquiry Ordered
item.description: A routine school outing in Jhabua ended in chaos after a malfunctioning fair ride injured 14 students, prompting hospitalisation and a magisterial inquiry into safety lapses.

item.title: Shockwaves in Haryana: Did a 9-Year-Old Girl Give Birth in Kaithal? Here’s the Truth Behind the Viral Video
item.description: Did a 9 year-old girl in Haryana's Kaithal gave birth to a baby? Here's the truth behind the viral video.

item.description: Sunita Williams Retires After 27-Year NASA Career, Conquering 608 Days and a Nine-Month Space Mission.
